description: A grid of stores for single voltages, one saved into the blue cell and one read back from the yellow cell

params.text: Saves the voltage at IN into the blue cell
Reads the voltage in the yellow cell out to OUT

inputs.text: The voltage that a save stores
Sets which column the blue cell is in, 0V to 10V across the grid
Sets which row the blue cell is in, 0V to 10V down the grid
Sets which column the yellow cell is in, 0V to 10V across the grid
Sets which row the yellow cell is in, 0V to 10V down the grid
A trigger here saves the voltage at IN into the blue cell
A trigger here reads the voltage in the yellow cell out to OUT

outputs.text: The voltage last read out of a cell

notes: left-clicking the grid moves the blue cell that a save writes to, and right-clicking moves the yellow cell that a load reads from
every cell starts empty, and a load from an empty cell sends nothing; a load also needs OUT to be patched before it will read a cell at all

inputs.5: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.6: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
